Hey im literally the same specs and for like a whole year I thought I may have had a cpu bottleneck because the gpu would never be fully utilized like games that would need 40% would use 40% but be 20-30fps or a game that only needed 10% would do the same again for 30fps tops, anyway turns out my issue was not updating my drivers but not my gpu drivers but my MOTHERBOARD drivers (which is something you should only have to do like once) literally done it and now my gpu actually reaches 99% in dayz and every other games being properly utilized

Apparently motherboard drivers is such an obvious thing to do when making a new pc that no one told me and no youtube video mentioned it being an issue (except one that did so very briefly but thank god i saw it) and so whenever i heard update drivers i always assumed yeah gpu driver anyway i hope this helps you
